description: This Java class `ExternalServicesConfigurationHelper` provides utility methods for interacting with external service configurations within the Apache Fineract integration testing framework. It includes methods for retrieving configuration by service name and updating configuration values, although these are marked as deprecated. The class contains references to external libraries such as Gson and RestAssured for JSON processing and HTTP requests.
